```{r}
home_url <- "https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/lakes/waterquality/"

# Read the main page
home_page <- read_html(home_url)

# Extract county links
county_nodes <- home_page %>%
  html_elements("a")

county_links <- tibble(
  county = html_text2(county_nodes),
  href = html_attr(county_nodes, "href")
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(href),
    str_detect(href, "Stations\\.aspx\\?location=")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    county_url = url_absolute(href, home_url)
  ) %>%
  distinct(county_url, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Inspect results
print(county_links)
nrow(county_links)

get_county_stations <- function(county_url, county, b,
                                load_timeout = 60,
                                page_timeout = 30) {

  county <- stringr::str_trim(county)

  message("\nStarting: ", county)

  b$Page$navigate(county_url)

  # Wait for the station table to appear
  table_loaded <- FALSE

  for (i in seq_len(load_timeout)) {
    Sys.sleep(1)

    table_loaded <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
      "!!document.querySelector(
        '#ctl00_ctl00_LeftPageContent_gvStationTable'
      )",
      returnByValue = TRUE
    )$result$value

    if (isTRUE(table_loaded)) {
      break
    }
  }

  if (!isTRUE(table_loaded)) {
    warning("Could not load station table for ", county)
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  all_stations <- list()

  repeat {

    # Get current page and total pages
    page_info <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
      "(() => {
        const txt = document.querySelector(
          '#ctl00_ctl00_LeftPageContent_gvStationTable'
        ).innerText;

        const m = txt.match(/Page\\s+(\\d+)\\s+of\\s+(\\d+)/);

        return m ? {current: Number(m[1]), total: Number(m[2])} : null;
      })()",
      returnByValue = TRUE
    )$result$value

    if (is.null(page_info)) break

    current_page <- page_info$current
    total_pages <- page_info$total

    message("  Page ", current_page, " of ", total_pages)

    # Extract station records
    station_rows <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
      "Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          '#ctl00_ctl00_LeftPageContent_gvStationTable tr'
        )
      )
      .map(row => Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td'))
        .map(cell => cell.innerText.trim())
      )
      .filter(row => row.length === 5)",
      returnByValue = TRUE
    )$result$value

    if (length(station_rows) > 0) {

      all_stations[[current_page]] <- purrr::map_dfr(
        station_rows,
        ~ tibble::tibble(
          station_name = .x[[1]],
          station_id = .x[[2]],
          most_recent_data = .x[[4]]
        )
      )
    }

    if (current_page >= total_pages) break

    # Click Next
    b$Runtime$evaluate(
      "document.querySelector(
        '#ctl00_ctl00_LeftPageContent_gvStationTable_ctl01_LinkButton3'
      ).click()",
      returnByValue = TRUE
    )

    # Wait until the page number changes
    page_changed <- FALSE

    for (i in seq_len(page_timeout)) {
      Sys.sleep(1)

      new_page <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
        "(() => {
          const txt = document.querySelector(
            '#ctl00_ctl00_LeftPageContent_gvStationTable'
          ).innerText;

          const m = txt.match(/Page\\s+(\\d+)\\s+of\\s+(\\d+)/);

          return m ? Number(m[1]) : null;
        })()",
        returnByValue = TRUE
      )$result$value

      if (!is.null(new_page) &&
          as.numeric(new_page) == current_page + 1) {
        page_changed <- TRUE
        break
      }
    }

    if (!page_changed) {
      warning("Pagination failed for ", county,
              " on page ", current_page)
      break
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(all_stations) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(county = county, .before = 1)
}

#now look for useable data

check_station_download <- function(
    station_id,
    download_dir = "WI_DNR_Raw_Profile_Data"
) {

  station_id <- as.character(station_id)

  dir.create(
    download_dir,
    showWarnings = FALSE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )

  url <- paste0(
    "https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/swims/LakesReport/DownloadTemperatureReport?stationId=",
    station_id
  )

  message("Checking station: ", station_id)

  # Request the download
  response <- tryCatch({

    request(url) %>%
      req_user_agent("Mozilla/5.0") %>%
      req_timeout(60) %>%
      req_perform()

  }, error = function(e) e)

  # Handle request failures
  if (inherits(response, "error")) {
    return(tibble(
      station_id = station_id,
      status = "request_failed",
      http_status = NA_integer_,
      n_records = NA_integer_,
      has_temperature = NA,
      has_dissolved_oxygen = NA,
      file_path = NA_character_,
      columns = NA_character_,
      message = conditionMessage(response)
    ))
  }

  http_status <- resp_status(response)
  content_type <- resp_header(response, "content-type")
  file_raw <- resp_body_raw(response)

  # Handle HTTP errors
  if (http_status != 200 || length(file_raw) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      station_id = station_id,
      status = "http_error_or_empty_response",
      http_status = http_status,
      n_records = NA_integer_,
      has_temperature = NA,
      has_dissolved_oxygen = NA,
      file_path = NA_character_,
      columns = NA_character_,
      message = content_type
    ))
  }

  # Identify the file format
  is_xlsx <- length(file_raw) >= 2 &&
    identical(as.integer(file_raw[1:2]), c(80L, 75L))

  is_xls <- length(file_raw) >= 8 &&
    identical(
      as.integer(file_raw[1:8]),
      c(208L, 207L, 17L, 224L, 161L, 177L, 26L, 225L)
    )

  # Check for an HTML response instead of a data file
  if (!is_xlsx && !is_xls) {

  preview <- rawToChar(
    file_raw[seq_len(min(length(file_raw), 1000))]
  )

  is_html <- grepl(
    "<!doctype html|<html|<body",
    preview,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

} else {
  is_html <- FALSE
}

  if (is_html) {
    return(tibble(
      station_id = station_id,
      status = "html_response",
      http_status = http_status,
      n_records = NA_integer_,
      has_temperature = NA,
      has_dissolved_oxygen = NA,
      file_path = NA_character_,
      columns = NA_character_,
      message = substr(preview, 1, 250)
    ))
  }

  if (is_xlsx) {
    extension <- ".xlsx"
  } else if (is_xls) {
    extension <- ".xls"
  } else {
    extension <- ".csv"
  }

  file_path <- file.path(
    download_dir,
    paste0(station_id, "_temperature_report", extension)
  )

  writeBin(file_raw, file_path)

  # Read the downloaded file
  profile_data <- tryCatch({

    if (is_xlsx || is_xls) {
      read_excel(file_path, col_types = "text")
    } else {
      read_csv(
        file_path,
        col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        progress = FALSE
      )
    }

  }, error = function(e) e)

  if (inherits(profile_data, "error")) {
    return(tibble(
      station_id = station_id,
      status = "file_parse_failed",
      http_status = http_status,
      n_records = NA_integer_,
      has_temperature = NA,
      has_dissolved_oxygen = NA,
      file_path = file_path,
      columns = NA_character_,
      message = conditionMessage(profile_data)
    ))
  }

  # Inspect column names for temperature and dissolved oxygen
  column_names <- names(profile_data)

# Check whether columns exist
has_temp <- any(
  str_detect(
    column_names,
    regex("temperature", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )
)

has_do <- any(
  str_detect(
    column_names,
    regex("dissox|dissolved.?oxygen", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )
)

# Check whether actual measurements exist
has_temp_data <- if (has_temp) {
  any(!is.na(profile_data$Temperature) &
        str_trim(profile_data$Temperature) != "")
} else {
  FALSE
}

has_do_data <- if (has_do) {
  any(!is.na(profile_data$Dissox) &
        str_trim(profile_data$Dissox) != "")
} else {
  FALSE
}

n_records <- nrow(profile_data)

tibble(
  station_id = station_id,
  status = if (n_records > 0) "downloaded" else "empty_file",
  http_status = http_status,
  n_records = n_records,
  has_temperature = has_temp,
  has_dissolved_oxygen = has_do,
  has_temperature_data = has_temp_data,
  has_dissolved_oxygen_data = has_do_data,
  file_path = file_path,
  columns = paste(column_names, collapse = "; "),
  message = content_type
)
}

station_ids <- unique(wi_stations$station_id)

download_results <- map_dfr(
  station_ids,
  function(id) {

    result <- check_station_download(id)

    Sys.sleep(0.25)

    result
  }
)

download_results %>%
  count(status)

download_results %>%
  filter(status == "downloaded") %>%
  summarise(
    stations_downloaded = n(),
    stations_with_temperature = sum(has_temperature_data),
    stations_with_dissolved_oxygen = sum(has_dissolved_oxygen_data),
    stations_with_both = sum(
      has_temperature_data & has_dissolved_oxygen_data
    )
  )

download_results %>% 
  filter(status == "empty_file") %>% 
  left_join(wi_stations, by = "station_id") %>% 
  glimpse()

write_csv(download_results, "download_results.csv")
```

Below directly uses the shiny app and is much slower
# Function for extracting

This uses a headless browser to basically open the webpage, navigate to a station webpage and download the data. The shiny app can be super slow (sometimes taking over 2 min to open for a lake). If 180 seconds is too slow to have the lake page open (download disabled remains TRUE), you may have to increase the time so that it allows the webpage to open properly. 
```{r}
download_station_profile <- function(
    station_id,
    b,
    download_dir = tempdir(),
    load_timeout = 250,
    download_timeout = 60
) {

  message("\nStarting station: ", station_id)

  # Build station URL
  url <- paste0(
    "https://dnr-wisconsin.shinyapps.io/WaterExplorer/?stationid=",
    station_id
  )

  # Navigate to station
  b$Page$navigate(url)

  # Wait for station data to load
  button_enabled <- FALSE

  for (i in seq_len(ceiling(load_timeout / 5))) {

    Sys.sleep(5)

    button_disabled <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
      "document.querySelector('#DLRawProfData')
        ?.classList.contains('disabled')",
      returnByValue = TRUE
    )$result$value

    elapsed <- i * 5

    message(
      "Station ", station_id,
      " | Elapsed: ", elapsed,
      " seconds | Download disabled: ", button_disabled
    )

    if (identical(button_disabled, FALSE)) {
      button_enabled <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }

  if (!button_enabled) {
    stop("Station ", station_id, " did not finish loading.")
  }

  # Extract download URL
  download_url <- b$Runtime$evaluate(
    "document.querySelector('#DLRawProfData').href",
    returnByValue = TRUE
  )$result$value

  if (is.null(download_url) || !nzchar(download_url)) {
    stop("Could not find download URL for station ", station_id)
  }

  # Expected download filename
  file_path <- file.path(
    download_dir,
    paste0(station_id, "_profile.csv")
  )

  # Remove an old download if one exists
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    unlink(file_path)
  }

  # Initiate download
  b$Page$navigate(download_url)

  # Wait for CSV to finish downloading
  download_complete <- FALSE

  for (i in seq_len(ceiling(download_timeout))) {

    Sys.sleep(1)

    if (
      file.exists(file_path) &&
      !file.exists(paste0(file_path, ".crdownload"))
    ) {
      download_complete <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }

  if (!download_complete) {
    stop("Download failed or timed out for station ", station_id)
  }

  # Read data and add station ID
  profile_data <- read_csv(
    file_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(station_id = station_id)

  message(
    "Successfully downloaded station ",
    station_id,
    " (", nrow(profile_data), " rows)"
  )

  return(profile_data)
}
```

```{r}
station_ids <- c(133318, 613121)

# Start browser session
b <- ChromoteSession$new()

# Set download behavior BEFORE downloading
b$Browser$setDownloadBehavior(
  behavior = "allow",
  downloadPath = tempdir()
)

# Download each station
profile_list <- lapply(
  station_ids,
  download_station_profile,
  b = b
)

# Combine into one dataframe
all_profiles <- bind_rows(
  lapply(profile_list, function(x) {
    x %>%
      mutate(
        `DISSOLVED OXYGEN FIELD` =
          as.character(`DISSOLVED OXYGEN FIELD`)
      )
  })
)

# Close browser
b$close()

glimpse(all_profiles)

# Number of records per station
all_profiles %>%
  count(station_id)

# Check downloaded files
list.files(
  tempdir(),
  pattern = "profile\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```
